svg.text: 11 Bridge gallery / 12 Radar platform / 13 Radar screen / 14 Aft signal tower
11 / Keep flat. Glue its underside to island guide 11, centred with an even 4 mm side overhang.
Guide 8 faces the bow. Glue bridge 8 on top; the gallery extends 2 mm beyond each bridge wall.
12 / Keep flat. Centre on foremast 10: 4 mm overhang at each end, 3 mm on either side.
13 / Fold the lavender foot away from the printed screen to make a right angle. Glue its printed face
to guide 13 on platform 12. The screen stands along the port edge; the foot points toward starboard.
14 / Fold walls down, match lettered corners, then glue base tabs onto deck guide 14 aft of the island.
Fine grey marks are printed detail, not cuts. Only bold outside outlines are cut; blue dashes are folds.
Keep all parts from the same version. This paper prototype still needs a physical test assembly.
A4 landscape | Actual size / 100% | Single-sided | No fit-to-page
